title: Especialista em Performance Web Front-End
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital. Somos globais, somos GPTW.


Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Performance Web Front-End apaixonado(a) por otimizar a velocidade, a responsividade e a experiência do usuário das nossas aplicações web. O foco principal é garantir o carregamento ultrarrápido das páginas, melhorar as métricas de Core Web Vitals e aplicar as melhores práticas de SEO Técnico, resultando em melhor posicionamento nos mecanismos de busca e aumento nas taxas de conversão.


Principais Responsabilidades

1. Otimização de Performance:

- Analisar, diagnosticar e solucionar gargalos de performance no Front-End (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, imagens, fontes).

- Focar na melhoria contínua das métricas Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) e outras métricas de velocidade (TTFB, FCP, TTI).

- Implementar técnicas de otimização como code splitting, lazy loading, pré-carregamento de recursos (preloading/prefetching), compressão (Gzip/Brotli) e caching avançado.

2. SEO Técnico e Carregamento:

- Garantir a rastreabilidade (crawlability) e indexação eficiente das páginas por bots de mecanismos de busca.

- Otimizar a estrutura do DOM, o uso de HTML semântico e metatags.

- Trabalhar na renderização ideal (server-side, client-side ou híbrida/SSR) para equilibrar performance e SEO.

3. Monitoramento e Análise:

-Utilizar ferramentas como Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Google Search Console e ferramentas de RUM (Real User Monitoring) para monitorar e reportar a performance em ambientes de produção.

-Criar e manter dashboards de performance, identificando tendências e oportunidades de otimização.

4. Colaboração e Educação:

-Colaborar de perto com equipes de Design (UX/UI), Back-End e Marketing/SEO para garantir que as novas funcionalidades sejam lançadas com alta performance e aderência técnica.

-Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e atuar como um mentor técnico, disseminando a cultura de performance para toda a equipe de Front-End.


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais (Hard Skills)


• Proficiência em: HTML semântico, CSS (incluindo pré-processadores ou CSS-in-JS) e JavaScript moderno (ES6+).

• Domínio de Frameworks/Bibliotecas: Experiência avançada em pelo menos um dos principais frameworks de Front-End (React, Vue.js ou Angular), com foco na otimização de builds e carregamento.

• Otimização de Assets: Conhecimento profundo em otimização de imagens (WebP, AVIF, tag), font loading (FOIT, FOUT) e minificação de código.

• Ferramentas de Build/Bundling: Experiência com ferramentas como Webpack, Rollup ou Vite, configurando otimizações para produção.

• Infraestrutura/Rede: Entendimento de redes (HTTP/2, HTTP/3), Content Delivery Networks (CDN) e estratégias de cache no navegador e no servidor.

• SEO Técnico: Conhecimento em Sitemap, Robots.txt, canonicalização, dados estruturados (Schema.org) e experiências de usuário mobile.


Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


• Foco em Resultados: Orientação clara para melhorias mensuráveis (KPIs) de performance e SEO.

• Resolução de Problemas Complexos: Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas que atravessam múltiplas camadas (navegador, rede, servidor, código).

• Comunicação: Habilidade para explicar problemas técnicos complexos e as soluções propostas para audiências não técnicas (marketing, gestão).

• Aprendizado Contínuo: Manter-se atualizado com as constantes mudanças nos algoritmos de busca e nas tecnologias de otimização web.


Diferenciais

• Experiência com SSR (Server-Side Rendering) ou SSG (Static Site Generation) usando frameworks como Next.js ou Nuxt.js.

• Conhecimento de PWA (Progressive Web Apps) e estratégias offline-first.

Experiência em plataformas de Cloud Computing (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) para otimizar o deployment e a entrega.


Habilidades:


Habilidades Técnicas:


- GOOGLE CORE WEB VITALS

- LCP

- CLS

- TTFB

- GOOGLE LIGHTHOUSE

- DASHBOARDS DE PERFORMANCE

- DESIGN DE EXPERIENCIA DO USUARIO (UX/UI)

- HTML semântico

- CSS AVANCADO

- JAVASCRIPT MODERNO (ES6+)

- DESENVOLVEDOR REACT

- DESENVOLVIMENTO COM NEXT.JS

- Nuxt.js

- PWA (PROGRESSIVE WEB APPS)

- ADMINISTRACAO DA CLOUD AWS

- PROCESSAMENTO DE SITEMAPS

- DATADOG RUM (REAL USER MONITORING)


Habilidades Comportamentais:


- Foco em resultados

- Resolução de problemas complexos

- COMUNICATIVO

- Adaptação e Aprendizado Contínuo


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!


Assistência médica;

VR e VA flexível;

Gympass e Wellz;

Parceria com o SESC;

Descontos em restaurantes;

Descontos em cursos técnicos e de ensinos superior;

Descontos em escolas e plataformas de idiomas.


E aí, aceita o desafio? Então conclua sua candidatura e #VemSerFoursys! Boa sorte!

description:

A área de recrutamento ainda está se estruturando, por isso buscamos alguém que não apenas conduza processos seletivos de ponta a ponta, mas que também curta o desafio de criar, evoluir e implementar boas práticas na área.

Se você tem experiência com posições de tecnologia , gosta de ambientes dinâmicos, menos estruturados e repletos de oportunidades de aprendizado , essa vaga é pra você!


Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto

Tipo de contrato: PJ


Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir processos seletivos de ponta a ponta (kick-off, hunting, triagem, entrevistas, feedbacks e fechamento);
  • Realizar hunting ativo, especialmente para posições de tecnologia;
  • Gerenciar candidatos e vagas via Gupy (ATS) ;
  • Conduzir e dar andamento ao programa de indicações internas;
  • Fazer alinhamentos frequentes com lideranças contratantes, garantindo clareza e alinhamento de expectativas;
  • Construir e manter pipelines de talentos para posições futuras;
  • Conduzir entrevistas por competências, avaliando tanto aspectos técnicos quanto comportamentais;
  • Priorizar diversidade, equidade e inclusão nos processos seletivos;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de Employer Branding em momentos de menor volume de vagas;
  • Atuar em um ambiente de startup em crescimento , colaborando para a evolução de processos, políticas e boas práticas de recrutamento;
  • Acompanhar e analisar métricas de recrutamento (SLA, tempo de fechamento, conversão de etapas), gerando insights de melhoria;
  • Organizar e priorizar demandas em cenários de alto volume de processos.


Perfil desejado:

  • Experiência prévia em recrutamento e seleção;
  • Vivência com recrutamento de posições de tecnologia ;
  • Familiaridade com ATS ;
  • Experiência em entrevistas por competências ;
  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade de construir relações de confiança com gestores e candidatos;
  • Organização, capacidade analítica e agilidade para lidar com múltiplas vagas;
  • Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade para atuar em um ambiente de startup;
  • Vontade constante de aprender e se desenvolver.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com programas de diversidade, equidade e inclusão ;
  • Vivência em projetos de Employer Branding ;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de recrutamento (SLA, tempo de fechamento, conversão de etapas);
  • Espanhol avançado .

title: Business Development & Partnerships Specialist
description:
UserGuiding is a SaaS product that helps web applications show their value propositions by enabling them to improve their ease of use. Interactive product tours, which can be created without coding, help product managers, marketers, and UX designers to make changes to the interfaces of their platforms. Personalized guides, built-in minutes, decrease the customer support workload by accelerating the onboarding process.


Role Objective


The main goal of this role is to increase our pipeline and generate demand in Brazil by building strong relationships with associations, influencers, and communities.


The person in this position will work closely with the marketing team , reporting weekly on partnerships, events, and lead generation metrics. 


Main Responsibilities


1. Partnerships & Outreach


  • Identify and build relationships with associations, communities (e.g., ABStartups), and influencers.
  • Organize partnership calls and follow up with stakeholders.
  • Create and maintain a list of relevant industry events.
  • Conduct market research to identify trends, opportunities, and potential partners in the ecosystem.
  • Attend or represent the company at local events, meetups, and workshops.
  • Host or co-host online / offline events and product demos.


2. Community & Customer Relations


  • Lead and grow our community presence in Brazil.
  • Build strong relationships with customers and webinar attendees.
  • Engage with users and prospects on LinkedIn; send connection requests, interact with posts, and identify advocates.
  • Understand customer needs and collect insights to improve local strategy and messaging for different purposes, such as ad copies.
  • Help with local content creation (reports, articles, or interviews in PT-BR).


3. Brand Awareness


  • Explore PR opportunities to feature the company in relevant Brazilian magazines, online blogs, podcasts, social media influencers, and panels.
  • Coordinate or organize small gatherings, dinners, or networking events for target audiences.
  • Represent the company in local communities and industry discussions.



Skills & Tools


Business Development Tools


  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator (prospecting & outreach)
  • HubSpot CRM (lead tracking, pipeline management, email sequences)
  • Apollo.io and similars (contact enrichment)
  • Google Sheets (for organizing lists of events, influencers, and associations)
  • Zoom / Meet / Loom (for calls and demos)


Marketing & Community Tools


  • Contrast (organizing events)
  • Canva 
  • Slack / WhatsApp / Discord (for community or internal comms)


Skillset Needed


  • Strong networking and relationship-building ability
  • Excellent written and spoken Portuguese (and English for coordination)
  • Public speaking or hosting confidence (for webinars/podcasts)
  • Strategic thinking and curiosity about the software ecosystem in Brazil
  • Strong project management.
  • Native Spanish speaking is more than welcome. :)

title: Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Java Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Work with software development teams to gather requirements and ensure best practices are adhered.

- Design, Implement & Support solutions for application development, security, analytics and performance management.

- Conform to existing industry security coding standards adhering to fortify scan and other security tool review requirements.

- Conduct code reviews for junior members of the team and do peer code reviews to make sure code is following standards set forward by the architects.

- Run test scripts against code to ensure quality delivery.

- Resolve code issues with urgency.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience in Java.

- Experience in web application programming.

- Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming.

- Ability to work with relational and non-relational bases.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Brazil | SRE, Java & .NET Engineers (Remote)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Our mission is to be a meaningful part of our people's careers. As we grow, so does our determination to offer the best experience to our employees and clients — and that’s exactly what drives us. We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with offices in Lisbon, Porto and Óbidos, and representations in Brazil and Tunisia. We have over 12 years of market expertise, and today we are a universe of around 400 people working on-site, remotely or in hybrid mode in projects across 20+ countries.


We believe that great people make successful companies, and that’s why we stand for the appreciation, recognition and growth of our professionals.


We don’t want to be just another line on your CV — we want you to live a Lifetime Experience with us. We invest in training and certifications that confirm your real progression, in promoting a healthy work-life balance, and in offering benefits that impact your personal life and career.


#welcometoyourfuture

Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)

⚙️ Java Engineer

– 4 to 6 years of experience in Java development

– Interest in learning new technologies , such as Python

– Experience with integration, APIs, testing, and troubleshooting

title: Administrative Analyst
description:
We are looking for an Operations Admin to support our Central Operations team and US Operations markets in general administrative tasks and onboarding growth. If you are a well organized, analytical person with exceptional communication and problem solving skills then this role may be for you!



What You’ll Focus On:

  • Support our US Operations Cities on growth deliverables and efficiencies in our day to day work and operations
  • Automations for our ways of working when it comes to growth and portfolio changes
  • Analyze data in order to create and prepare detailed reports for the leadership team that effectively communicate trends, patterns, and predictions using relevant data
  • Standardize our ways of working across markets to improve timeliness and execution on furnishings and move-outs
  • Perform audits and improve data metrics for our guests and internal teams, as well as manage timely data collection to update productivity and achievements on projects
  • Unit/Building/Process information entry, ensuring all fields are accurately filled and clear for other teams
  • Collaborate with operational team members and organizational leaders to identify gaps and opportunities for process improvements
  • Communicate with third party vendors and companies if needed to support OPS/CX operations
  • Specific admin support related to onboarding and move-out of units for our US cities including:
  • Complete utility and telecommunication setups for new units with third party companies (create online portals, set up payments, and input data into our internal system)
  • Complete Package Setups for new units (create online portals, set up payments, and input data into our internal system)
  • Cancel utility and telecommunication accounts for move-outs
  • Support the scheduling of furnishing and onboarding tasks and move-outs:
  • Communicate with third party vendors and buildings to schedule pick ups
  • Input data into our system related to our properties
  • Track disposal and data related to move-outs
  • Support Central Operations, OPS local team, and finance/accounting with ad-hoc projects



What we are looking for:

  • Degree from a top-tier university
  • Min. 1-2 years of experience in a similar role (administrative experience in residential or hospitality experience will be considered as a plus)
  • Fluency in English
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel (formulation, data entry, charts, pivot tables) and Powerpoint
  • Self-starter with a roll up your sleeves mentality and high attention to detail
  • Entrepreneurial drive, adaptability, and focus on results
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and with speed

  • Conhecimento avançado em bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle , PostgreSQL ) e NoSQL (MongoDB , DynamoDB ).
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de microserviços , incluindo padrões de comunicação (REST , gRPC ).

  • Implementação de testes robustos (unitários, integração, e2e) com frameworks como JUnit , Mockito e Testcontainers .

  • Experiência com observabilidade (Tracing, Metrics, Logging).
  • Domínio em ferramentas como OpenAPI e Swagger para documentação de APIs.

O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Site Reliability Engineer Sr (SRE Sr)

  • Criar, manter e escalar soluções resilientes, de alta disponibilidade e performance em cloud.
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD com foco em automatização;
  • Automatizar tudo que for possível (IaC, pipelines, deploys).
  • Otimizar performance, definir e monitorar SLOs junto ao time de produto.

title: Lead Web Designer
description:
Lead Web Designer Job Description

Location: Remote; ability to work in US EST time zone required

Type: Freelance


About BX Studio

BX Studio is one of the world’s leading Enterprise Webflow agencies—and the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year. We specialize in launching custom websites, ongoing website optimization, and digital branding.

We’re a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world’s most forward-thinking brands.

We’ve partnered with Reddit, Headspace, NBC, and Verifone, spoken at Webflow Conf four times, and have been a trusted Webflow Enterprise Partner since 2020.


The Role

We’re looking for a Lead Web Designer to own management and execution of web projects for our SaaS and B2B clients. This role is a fit for a Sr. Designer ready to step up, an Associate Design Director from a smaller shop looking to grow within a larger team, or a Lead Web Designer seeking to advance their career within a high-growth agency.

The Lead Web Designer is both hands-on and strategic: you’ll design systems, shape web content strategies, and present creative directions to clients with clarity and confidence. You’ll also provide leadership to mid-level and junior designers, working with a Design Director to help shape creative vision while setting standards for quality, process, and visual storytelling.


What You’ll Do

  • Own the creative process from strategy through design execution, ensuring each web project delivers clarity, impact, and BX-level quality.
  • Develop visual identity systems from scratch in short timeframes, adapting them into cohesive, scalable websites.
  • Lead web content strategy—structuring information, messaging, and design patterns to maximize storytelling and usability.
  • Design websites in Webflow-first workflows, collaborating closely with developers for seamless execution.
  • Present and pitch creative work directly to clients, explaining decisions with clarity and confidence.
  • Mentor and guide mid-level and junior designers, elevating their work and modeling best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (graphics, UX, dev) to bring ambitious websites to life.
  • Implement and refine processes within the design team to ensure smooth collaboration, efficient iteration, and consistent high quality.
  • Stay ahead of trends in web design, storytelling, and Webflow workflows—bringing new ideas into BX Studio projects.


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–7 years of web design experience, ideally with B2B companies, SaaS brands, and digital-first identities.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end web projects: strategy, visual identity, UX/UI, and final design execution.
  • Proven ability to lead client conversations and present creative directions with clarity and confidence.
  • Experience developing visual identity systems and scalable design systems applied across digital experiences.
  • Solid foundation in content strategy, information architecture, and UX principles.
  • Proficiency in modern design tools (Figma required; Adobe Creative Suite a plus).
  • Webflow knowledge required; familiarity with responsive best practices and handoff to development.
  • Strong leadership potential—experience mentoring or leading designers highly preferred.
  • Process-oriented mindset: able to shape workflows and uphold creative standards in a fast-paced agency environment.


Why Join BX Studio?

  • Lead ambitious web projects for innovative B2B and SaaS brands.
  • Step into a role that bridges Sr. Designer and Associate Design Director responsibilities.
  • Grow your leadership skills while still working hands-on with design.
  • Collaborate with a talented, supportive, and high-standard team in a flexible remote environment.

  • Mentor and guide mid-level and junior designers, elevating their work and modeling best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (graphics, UX, dev) to bring ambitious websites to life.
  • Implement and refine processes within the design team to ensure smooth collaboration, efficient iteration, and consistent high quality.
  • Stay ahead of trends in web design, storytelling, and Webflow workflows—bringing new ideas into BX Studio projects.


What We’re Looking For

  • 5–7 years of web design experience, ideally with B2B companies, SaaS brands, and digital-first identities.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end web projects: strategy, visual identity, UX/UI, and final design execution.
  • Proven ability to lead client conversations and present creative directions with clarity and confidence.
  • Experience developing visual identity systems and scalable design systems applied across digital experiences.
  • Solid foundation in content strategy, information architecture, and UX principles.
  • Proficiency in modern design tools (Figma required; Adobe Creative Suite a plus).
  • Webflow knowledge required; familiarity with responsive best practices and handoff to development.
  • Strong leadership potential—experience mentoring or leading designers highly preferred.
  • Process-oriented mindset: able to shape workflows and uphold creative standards in a fast-paced agency environment.


Why Join BX Studio?

  • Lead ambitious web projects for innovative B2B and SaaS brands.
  • Step into a role that bridges Sr. Designer and Associate Design Director responsibilities.
  • Grow your leadership skills while still working hands-on with design.
  • Collaborate with a talented, supportive, and high-standard team in a flexible remote environment.

description:
About the Company: Genpact (NYSE: G) is a global professional services and solutions firm delivering outcomes that shape the future. Our 125,000+ people across 30+ countries are driven by our innate curiosity, entrepreneurial agility, and desire to create lasting value for clients. Powered by our purpose the relentless pursuit of a world that works better for people we serve and transform leading enterprises, including the Fortune Global 500, with our deep business and industry knowledge, digital operations services, and expertise in data, technology, and AI.


About the Role: Genpact is urgently looking for a strong Consultant for one of our precious clients in USA. If you are interested kindly share profile at


Title: SAP BPC Specialist

Location: Uberlandia, Brazil / REMOTE

Duration: Contract


Responsibilities:

  • Bridging Finance and Tech - FP&A knowhow with SAP functional knowledge can effectively translate financial req into system configurations, for planning, reporting, and forecasting (all three or per their current challenges)
  • System-Driven Financial Accuracy - SAP BPC and SAC requires a deep understanding of financial data flows, hierarchies, and consolidation logic— by someone who understands both finance principles and SAP structures.
  • Financial Acumen - FP&A expertise; understanding of P&L drivers, budgeting logic, and variance analysis—critical for validating system outputs and ensuring financial integrity in reporting
  • Root-Cause Resolution Capability - Key to this role is the ability to reverse-engineer financial reports with data issues, determine whether the problem is from template design or source system data, and coordinate fixes with IT or finance accordingly.
  • Sustained System Enhancement & Governing : Improvement of SAP-based planning and reporting processes would need someone who understands both system limitations and financial controls within FP&A (though mostly i think this will be managed at either the project level or by Thuy or someone in the team)





Best Regards,

Manohar Swamy

title: Program Manager
description:
Job Title: Sr. Service Deployment Program Manager (2 openings) - Contractor

Location: Remote (occasional travel to client sites; expenses covered)


About the Role

We are supporting one of our clients in the search for an experienced Service Deployment Program Manager to lead the implementation of complex technology platforms in on-premises environments.

This professional will oversee all phases of service delivery — from planning and coordination to testing and deployment — ensuring successful integration and client satisfaction.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Deployment Projects: Manage end-to-end platform deployments in on-premises environments, ensuring timely and within-budget delivery.
  • Service Delivery Management: Oversee all aspects of service delivery and ensure alignment with client requirements and best practices.
  • RACI Development: Define roles and responsibilities across stakeholders to ensure clarity and accountability throughout the project.
  • Network Design & Documentation: Create detailed network diagrams and ensure compliance with security standards.
  • Testing & Validation: Develop and execute comprehensive test plans covering performance, functionality, and security.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Act as a liaison between clients, vendors, and technical teams, maintaining transparent communication and progress tracking.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Identify potential risks, propose mitigations, and ensure smooth execution of deployments.
  • Reporting & Continuous Improvement: Maintain detailed documentation and propose process enhancements for future projects.


Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in project/program management focused on on-premises platform deployments .
  • Technical Knowledge:
  • Strong understanding of network architecture, integrations (API, DevOps) , and platform deployment models .
  • Hands-on experience creating RACIs, test plans , and managing complex delivery timelines.
  • Project Management: Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deliver results under tight deadlines.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to bridge technical and non-technical teams.
  • Certifications: PMP or similar certification highly desirable.
  • Mindset: Analytical, proactive, and focused on delivery excellence.

title: Gerente de Tecnologia
description:
Empresa Confidencial está em busca de profissionais em nível gerencial para integrar o time de Tecnologia da Informação.


Descrição do cargo:

O Gerente de Tecnologia será responsável por liderar de forma estratégica e operacional as iniciativas da área de TI, garantindo a sustentação de soluções tecnológicas alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio. Atuará como parceiro das áreas corporativas e operacionais, promovendo inovação, segurança, eficiência e escalabilidade nos processos e sistemas da organização.

Estamos com oportunidades abertas na área de Tecnologia e buscamos profissionais que possam atuar em diferentes frentes, de acordo com sua experiência e especialidade.


Nosso olhar é abrangente e considera perfis que possam integrar áreas como: Business Intelligence e Análise de Dados, Infraestrutura de TI, Segurança da Informação, Desenvolvimento de Software, Governança de TI, Arquitetura de Sistemas, Produtos Digitaise Cloud Computing


Se você tem experiência em uma ou mais dessas áreas e busca um ambiente dinâmico, que valoriza o desenvolvimento, a colaboração e a transformação digital, essa pode ser uma excelente oportunidade para você.


Requisitos:

Buscamos profissionais com formação superior completa em áreas correlatas à Tecnologia da Informação, que tenham trajetória consolidada em posições de liderança e visão estratégica da área. Valorizamos quem alia conhecimento técnico e de gestão, com capacidade de atuar de forma integrada e próxima ao negócio. Ter vivência com gestão de equipes multidisciplinares, domínio de boas práticas de TI e familiaridade com temas ligados à inovação, segurança da informação e transformação digital serão diferenciais importantes.


A experiência prévia em empresas de concessões e/ou infraestrutura, s erá considerada um diferencial relevante. Além disso, é imprescindível possuir mobilidade nacional , uma vez que as oportunidades podem envolver atuação em diferentes localidades do país.


Se você é uma pessoa com perfil colaborativo, que gosta de construir junto, engajar times e transformar realidades por meio da tecnologia, queremos te conhecer.

title: UI/UX Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right. We’re seeking experienced, creative graphic designers to join our growing team.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Our business is expanding globally, and we need talented folks on our team to continue offering stellar service to our clients.



What We’re Looking For


We’re looking for team players who live and breathe design. People who are creative powerhouses and thrive on pushing boundaries and finding ways to bring fresh ideas to life. Ready to join our team and start designing?


About You


  • You’re super motivated and genuinely passionate about nailing the job every time.
  • You’re a problem-solver, always a few steps ahead and never caught off guard.
  • You bring good vibes to the table—you’re respectful, friendly, and a great collaborator.
  • You’re a time management wizard.
  • You’re a team player
  • Communication is your jam—clear, concise, and always spot-on.
  • You’re resourceful—if you don’t know something, you don’t flinch. You’ve got Google, you’ve got grit, and you always figure it out.
  • Bonus points if you geek out on things like DND, Pokémon, or video games. Our team’s got some serious nerd cred, and we’re looking for like-minded peeps to join!


Qualifications and Skills


  • 2+ years of hands-on design experience—show us your growth and expertise
  • Proficiency in Figma and Webflow. You know the ins and outs of these tools like your favourite video game’s cheat codes
  • Mastery of the Adobe Creative Suite: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign—you live and breathe these tools.
  • A killer design portfolio that shows off your best work.
  • Working level of English (enough to communicate your ideas clearly, both in writing and speaking).
  • A bachelor’s degree is a plus.
  • Comfortable with Microsoft Office & Google Workspace (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and their Google equivalents).
  • Comfortable designing for various media—digital, print, and even big formats.
  • Eager to dabble with AI in your workflow, and you’re open to new tech that enhances your creativity.
  • Know your way around social media graphics formatting—you get the vibe.
  • A knack for creating cohesive designs from brand identity guidelines (without breaking a sweat).
  • You can whip up mockups for design presentations like a true pro.


Bonus Points


  • You worship Canva or other online tools like it’s your creative playground.
  • You’re into AI design tools—we think they’re pretty rad, and you should too!



Our operating hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. MST.


Ready for the ride of your life? If you think you’re the perfect fit for the role, submit your resume & portfolio today!

title: Node Tech Lead - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Node Tech Leads to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Works with the team to determine the needs of the global technical architecture.

- Identifies the integration points for third party and existing systems.

- Validates that all technical choices will integrate with the final solution and adheres to the technical contracts defined for integration.


Requirements:


- 7+ years of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
Procurando um trabalho remoto onde suas habilidades técnicas e visão de produto possam realmente fazer a diferença?


Você está no lugar certo!


Somos a NEXT , uma empresa de Marketing de Resposta Direta com atuação no mercado dos Estados Unidos.


Estamos abrindo um novo braço tecnológico para o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, SaaS e aplicativos mobile , e buscamos um Desenvolvedor Mobile para fazer parte dessa fase de crescimento e inovação.


Na NEXT, unimos estratégia, dados e tecnologia para criar soluções de alto impacto. E agora, estamos dando um passo além — com o App focado na Bíblia , um aplicativo focado em estudos e jornadas de transformação pessoal baseadas na escritura sagrada , que combina fé e tecnologia para gerar crescimento espiritual de forma prática e acessível.


Este é um momento empolgante para se juntar à equipe: estamos crescendo, lançando novos produtos e construindo tecnologia própria.


Isso significa muitas oportunidades para aprender, evoluir e deixar sua marca em um ambiente que valoriza autonomia, propósito e excelência técnica .


Se você quer participar da construção de um app com propósito real, que une design, performance e impacto , e trabalhar ao lado de pessoas que vivem o que fazem com energia e visão de futuro — esse é o seu lugar.


SOBRE A VAGA:


  • Atenção! Apenas aplicações pelo Google Forms serão consideradas.


Responsabilidades

  • Implementar features em React Native + TypeScript  do início ao fim.
  • Definir a arquitetura do app  (navegação, estado, dados, cache/offline).
  • Integrar APIs REST/GraphQL/WebSocket  com tratamento de erros e timeouts.
  • Cuidar de performance : tempo de abertura, fluidez, memória e bateria.
  • Escrever testes (unitários e e2e)  e revisar PRs.
  • Preparar e operar releases (CI/CD, versões, ambientes, feature flags) .
  • Publicar e manter o app na App Store e Play Store .
  • Tratar segurança e privacidade : armazenamento local, tokens e permissões.
  • Instrumentar métricas, logs e crash reports  e agir sobre elas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com design e PM  para definir escopo, critérios de aceite e prazos.


Competências Técnicas

  • React Native e TypeScript sólidos (componentes, hooks, acessibilidade, animações básicas).
  • Gerenciamento de estado e dados (cache, paginação, updates otimistas, sync em background).
  • Deep links, notificações push, permissões, uploads/downloads de mídia, temas e i18n.
  • Integração de APIs com retries, backoff e versionamento.
  • Testes com Jest/RTL e e2e (Detox/Maestro); lint/format; documentação objetiva.
  • CI/CD: build, assinatura, canais (internal/beta/prod), OTA quando aplicável.
  • Noções de backend em TypeScript para desenhar/consumir APIs e logs.
  • Comunicação clara, capacidade de quebrar problemas em etapas e atenção aos detalhes.


Diferenciais 

  • Experiência com apps em grande escala e rollouts graduais .
  • Pagamentos/assinaturas in-app .
  • Otimização de listas grandes e mídia (compressão, pré-carregamento).
  • Acessibilidade avançada  (VoiceOver/TalkBack).
  • Segurança extra (obfuscação leve, certificate pinning).


Perfil que buscamos

  • Mentalidade de resolução de problemas  (não apenas execução).
  • Gosto por aprender e evoluir rápido .
  • Comunicação clara e vontade de crescer com o time.


Modelo de contratação

  • Remuneração compatível com nível técnico e experiência + bônus por performance
  • 100% remoto

title: Coordenador de RH
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador de RH para uma empresa localizada em Belém/PA .


Seu perfil corresponde ao da vaga descrita abaixo? Então, faça sua candidatura!


Objetivo da posição:

Buscamos um Coordenador de RH para atuar na principal planta da companhia. Este profissional terá um chapéu duplo, sendo responsável por toda a agenda de RH (recrutamento e seleção, treinamento e desenvolvimento, departamento pessoal, cultura e clima) dentro dessa unidade industrial, e, ao mesmo tempo, participará da elaboração de políticas junto ao time corporativo. O profissional se reportará a Gerente de RH Corporativa e terá a gestão de uma equipe de 5 profissionais.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gestão de pessoas
  • Gestão de subsistemas, como recrutamento e seleção, treinamento e desenvolvimento, departamento pessoal, cultura e clima
  • Elaboração de políticas para time industrial


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência prévia em Indústria
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de pessoas
  • Graduação completa
  • Atuação prévia dentro do RH, principalmente com os subsistemas de DHO e/ou DP


Sobre a FESA Group:

Fundada em 1995, a FESA Group é uma empresa brasileira que apoia organizações em toda a jornada estratégica de gestão de pessoas: do recrutamento executivo ao desenvolvimento de lideranças e à transformação cultural. Referência em seu setor de atuação, combina inteligência de mercado, especialização setorial e tecnologia, tendo a felicidade corporativa como parte essencial do seu DNA.

Seu portfólio integrado oferece soluções sob medida para aquisição, desenvolvimento, sucessão e retenção de talentos, sempre com foco no cliente e na entrega de resultados que geram impacto real nos negócios e na vida das pessoas. Mais do que autoridade nos setores em que atua — como Agronegócio, Indústria, Energia e Infraestrutura, Mercado Financeiro e Varejo —, conta com consultores especialistas preparados para criar conexões humanas que impulsionam crescimento e transformação.

Com presença em todo o Brasil por meio de escritórios regionais e atuação internacional via IIC Partners, presente em mais de 30 países, a FESA Group alia alcance global à expertise local. No campo social, o Instituto FESA C.R.O.M.A promove programas de voluntariado voltados à educação e qualificação profissional de jovens em situação de vulnerabilidade, reforçando seu compromisso com uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.

Para mais informações, acesse o site:
